collections.title: Linear Algebra · Foundations
collections.summary: Elimination and bases; determinants, orthogonality and eigenvectors; dual spaces and multilinear constructions. Continue to the matrix-operator bridge when ready.

collections.title: Matrix Operators · From Eigenvectors to Continuous Time
collections.summary: A four-lecture route from Cayley–Hamilton and the minimal polynomial to generalized eigenspaces, spectral projectors, and matrix exponentials.
assumed_background: Matrix multiplication, determinants, characteristic polynomials and simple eigenspaces. Basic derivatives and scalar exponentials are useful for the final lecture.
